name: Köhler Disease
definition: Self-limited osteochondrosis/osteonecrosis of the tarsal navicular, usually affecting young children and causing medial midfoot pain.

investigations.principle: Radiographs show flattened/sclerotic navicular in typical cases.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Short period of immobilization if painful
amber: The condition is generally self-limited; atypical age/course requires reassessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada/Asthi developmental phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Self-limited osteochondrosis/osteonecrosis of the tarsal navicular, usually affecting young children and causing medial midfoot pain.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
